description: This file implements the DirectOutput class's Output method, which logs messages either to syslog or to the console, depending on configuration. It is part of the Thunder::Messaging namespace and interacts with message info and event data.

classes.name: DirectOutput
classes.description: A class responsible for outputting messages to syslog or console.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Outputs a message of any type to syslog or console based on internal configuration.
